```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.choose n k = 2 ^ n := by
  induction n with d hd
  case zero =>
    rw [Finset.range_zero, Sum.empty, Nat.choose_zero_zero, Nat.pow_zero]
    rfl
  case succ d =>
    have key : ∑ k in Finset.range (d + 2), Nat.choose (d + 1) k = 2 ^ (d + 1) :=
      by rw [Nat.choose_add_left, Sum.add_right, hd, Nat.pow_succ]; rfl
    rw [Finset.range_succ, Sum.insert, Nat.choose_add_right, key]
```
